title: Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency: Per-Day Value of Earlier Late-Notice Credits Netted on Conversion
content:
**Patient accounts Q&A, conversions — Private Pay Long-Term Care Residency.** These answers concern the netted per-day amount of the conversion credit — the value per day of the late-notice credit days the conversion credit nets out.

**When the late-notice credit restored the earlier rate.** Where a rate notice delivery date is recorded on the agreement, the charge's span begins on or after 1 July 2026 (the current schedule's effective date) and the notice had not run its 60 days by the first day of the span, the netted per-day amount is the current schedule's daily rate for the tier the charge was posted for less the preceding schedule's daily rate for that tier:

| Tier the charge was posted for | Current less preceding, USD per day |
|---|---|
| Semi-Private Long-Term Care Room | 14.00 (398.00 less 384.00) |
| Semi-Private Secure Memory Care Room | 15.00 (427.00 less 412.00) |
| Private Long-Term Care Room | 15.00 (436.00 less 421.00) |
| Private Secure Memory Care Room | 16.00 (465.00 less 449.00) |
| Private Bariatric Care Room | 16.00 (482.00 less 466.00) |
| Private Suite with Sitting Area | 17.00 (514.00 less 497.00) |

**When that is not so and the charge carries credits.** The total of those credits divided by their days.

**Otherwise.** The charge's daily rate.

**Hypothetical case.** No notice gap; the charge carries one billing-error credit of 842.00 for 2 days: 421.00 a day.
